programmes.programName: Doctoral Program of the Department of Management Science and Technology
programmes.evidence: Official Management Science and Technology department homepage links its doctoral programme; opened programme page states approximately 55 students currently registered and describes live doctoral research. The qualifying term is in the official host department title; Logistics/Transportation examples are not recast as formal specializations. An official DMST Erasmus form for academic year 2026/27 identifies Management Science & Technology as the field and DOCTORAL degree as an available current degree level; this corroborates the doctoral credential, without claiming a separately titled PhD award.
limitations: The 2026/27 form establishes doctoral degree level; the official programme overview names the host department. Exact wording printed on an individual diploma remains unverified.

branches.conclusion: Official university page inventories three schools and eight departments; Management Science and Technology is the only formally qualifying department title. Its separate official overview explicitly names its Doctoral Program in Management Science and Technology. No duplicate degree is created from research themes.

University institutional inventory enumerates all eight departments across three schools, with no engineering school or Industrial Engineering department. Departmental doctoral specialization titles in non-qualifying host units were not individually inventoried; current scope completion therefore remains false.
